summary: Flex LNG Ltd. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited financial results for Q2 2026 and a press release. The filing reports vessel operating revenues of $106.8 million, net income of $44.9 million, and a declared dividend of $0.75 per share. No special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring is disclosed. The filing is a routine earnings announcement by a foreign private issuer, incorporating results into its existing F-3ASR shelf registration. There are no deal terms to analyze; the filing provides only operational and financial updates with no strategic corporate action to monitor.
